encryption_at_rest.key_management: AWS KMS with customer-managed keys (CMK) option

encryption_in_transit.standard: TLS 1.3 mandatory with fallback to TLS 1.2

business_continuity_and_dr.cross_region_replication: Active-passive replication between us-east-1 and us-west-2

access_control.mfa_requirement: Mandatory FIDO2 WebAuthn hardware security keys for all production engineers
access_control.password_complexity: Minimum 16 characters with PBKDF2 hashing at 600,000 iterations
